learning_objective: 🎯 Take a grand tour across India to explore the vibrant, diverse, and deeply cultural classical and folk dance forms!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India has ancient classical dances like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, and Odissi. These take years of practice and use highly detailed hand gestures to tell ancient mythological stories.
Folk dances like Bhangra, Garba, and Bihu celebrate harvests, seasons, and village festivals! They are full of high jumps, group circles, and pure, infectious joy.
In Indian dance, your hands do the talking! Mudras are specific hand signs that can represent a blooming lotus, a flying bird, or a fierce lion without saying a single word.

fun_activity.title: 🖐️ The Secret Mudra Message
fun_activity.instructions: Learn three basic hand mudras from an Indian classical dance online. Try to tell a short, silent story to your family using only your facial expressions and those three hand gestures!

quick_recap: ⭐ Classical dances follow strict ancient rules and use detailed gestures to tell sacred stories.
⭐ Folk dances are energetic community celebrations that express the joy of everyday life and nature.
⭐ Mudras act as a beautiful sign language, allowing dancers to speak vividly through their hands.
